+ आकार वृथा- + आकार, m. a vain, or useless appearance, Pañc. i. d. 62.
+ दान वृथा- + दान, unprofitable donation, gift to musicians, actresses, etc.,
+ मांस वृथा- + मांस, n. flesh which has not been sacrificed,

वृथा, i. e. वर + था, adv.
 1. Without pain (to one's own pleasure),

(वृथा-आलम्भ, m. Cutting or plucking unnecessarily).
 3. In vain,

; vain, Pañc. i. d. 62.
 4. Useless, fruitless, Pañc. iii. d. 31.
 5. Foolishly,

. Wrongly, incorrectly, Śṛṅgārat. 21.
 7. Without being sacrificed,

; 4, 213.
 --Cf. ῥεῖα, βρᾶ, ῥᾷ, ῥάϊστος, ῥᾷδιος, etc.
वृथा-संकर-जात (vb. जन्), adj. Born in vain (i. e. one who [] discharges not his duties), or by the mixture of different castes,
+ श्रम वृथा- + श्रम, m. vain exertion, Pañc. 116, 25.
+ समाचार वृथा-कुल- + समाचार, adj. descended from a low family and ill-behaved, Johns.
